content:
{
  "root_cause": "The Drawer component does not manage focus when opening; reliance on native dialog focus behavior did not move focus to the close button, leaving focus on the body and preventing keyboard navigation.",
  "repair_strategy": "Add a private handler that focuses the close button (#filters-close) on the 'shown.bs.drawer' event, attach this listener in the constructor after initializing the resize observer, and remove it in dispose to avoid leaks.",
  "expected_accessibility_effect": "When the filters drawer is opened via keyboard, focus will move to the close button, allowing sequential tabbing to filter controls and applying changes without a pointer.",
  "functional_risks": [
    "Potential focus conflict if other scripts also attempt to focus elements on the shown event, but the specific ID selector reduces this risk.",
    "Ensuring the listener does not cause focus loops or interfere with screen reader virtual cursor."
  ],
  "verification_requirements": [
    "After pressing Enter on #filters-open, focus is on #filters-close.",
    "Pressing Tab moves focus to #in-stock checkbox.",
    "Pressing Space toggles the checkbox state.",
    "Pressing Tab twice moves focus to the #apply button.",
    "Pressing Enter on #apply updates the applied output to 'in' and hides the drawer.",
    "Pressing Escape closes the drawer and returns focus to #filters-open."
  ]
}
